theorem.statement: Every W33 computational machine is classified by exactly three binary invariants: (R) reversibility, (C) chirality, (S) symmetry. The six machines A-F exhaust all non-degenerate combinations. Machine G is the unique maximally expressive reversible achiral machine.

proof_sketch.step3: Machine G is a distinct 7th machine (maximally expressive) but is classified as (R=true, C=false, S=true, expressive=maximal) — it extends Machine D with LEVI_MOBIUS.
proof_sketch.step4: No further machines exist: all binary invariant combinations are either realised or proved impossible.

R_true_S_true_C_true.reason: Symmetric means Levi-automorphism-invariant frame. Chiral means frame position 1 = 1 (asymmetric under Levi automorphism). These are mutually exclusive.
